<!-- Generated by docs-site/scripts/generate_reference.py from plugins/airgap-anything/skills/airgap-architect/references/agents-snippet.md. Do not edit. -->
Add the block below to `AGENTS.md` in the project root, creating the file if needed. If the block is already there, replace everything from its start marker to its end marker. Replace `BLUEPRINT_PATH` with the blueprint's path.

When `inside.operator` is `local_agent` or `people_then_agent`, also put the section "Rules for an agent inside the network" into the block, directly before the end marker. For `people`, leave it out.

If the project has a `CLAUDE.md` that does not import `AGENTS.md`, ask the user before adding the line `@AGENTS.md` to it.

```markdown
<!-- airgap-architect:start -->
## Air-gapped blueprint

This project follows the blueprint at `BLUEPRINT_PATH`. The artifacts to carry into the network are listed in `docs/airgap/transfer-manifest.md`.

- The target network has no internet access. Do not run a command that downloads anything; use the internal registry and mirrors.
- Use exactly the component versions pinned in the blueprint.
- Do not add a component, image, package or model that the blueprint does not list. Propose it as a blueprint change instead: the design is updated outside the network and carried in again.
- Decisions listed in the blueprint's verification section rest on estimates. Measure before relying on them.
<!-- airgap-architect:end -->
```

## Rules for an agent inside the network

```markdown
### Rules for an agent inside the network

The installation inside follows the bundle that `airgap-transfer` builds: its runbook `INSIDE.md`, its agent rules `AGENTS-INSIDE.md` and its checksum list `SHA256SUMS`.

- Run one command per step, exactly as the runbook gives it.
- Check the exit code of every command; 0 means go on.
- Stop at the first non-zero exit code and report the command, its exit code and its output.
- Never download anything, and never fetch a missing file from another source: a missing file is carried in again from outside.
- Never edit `SHA256SUMS` or the files it lists.
- Never improvise a step the runbook does not name. Ask a person instead.
```
